analyst_note: All four refuted findings concern timeline guidance for the catalyst trial (EXPLORER-CN Phase 3 in Chinese oHCM patients) and are marked minor severity. The company guided to mid-2023 data as early as August 2022 while the registry still showed November 2022 primary completion; the registry was later updated to April 2023, formalizing a 5-month slip. However, the marketing guidance was consistent and transparent about enrollment completion throughout this period. Timeline slips—especially those communicated in advance of registry updates and without attempt to conceal delays—do not constitute masking of likely clinical efficacy failures. No company-level honesty red flags (no fraud settlements, retractions, or misconduct findings) are present. The record is consistent with ordinary operational delay communication in a China-based registration trial.
